metadata.unmodeled_scope: All six sensor cases are retained and explicitly unaligned; no sensor waveform or interval dynamics are added here.
metadata.lifecycle_status: No verified lifecycle implementation; condition segments are provisional and may overlap or remain open.
metadata.core_variables: No numerical CANON core, L_P, or aggregate similarity score is computed.
metadata.ledger_value_contract: Numbers use exact lexical strings tagged type=number. Object values are ordered key/pointer edges; array values are ordered child pointers. Scalars retain their native decoded type/value. The typed tree and raw bytes are authoritative.
metadata.rebuild_scope: Regenerate from hash-pinned packaged sources; any accepted sibling sources present are checked for no mutation. No original sibling directory is required.
